summary: First test run of the imported OVIGO app (FastAPI + plain-HTML SPA). Backend: 15/15 pytest pass (health, static site, public sync tours, logins for admin/client/agency, wrong-password 401, client and agency sync data, register + duplicate 409 + validation 400, GET /api/admin/demo counts 200 for admin, 401 anon, 403 client/agency for both GET and DELETE). Frontend (Playwright): home loads with 'Prossime partenze', tour page opens, search '#cerca' shows 18 departures, client login shows the client area with 2 bookings, logout works, agency login opens the CRM dashboard, admin login opens Super admin with all Reparti sections plus 'Dati di prova' (demo-total=283, per-type table, demo-delete-btn visible). Clicking delete and dismissing the confirm dialog keeps the data. UI signup works and lands in #cliente with the 'Account creato' toast. NOT RUN: the actual DELETE /api/admin/demo bulk deletion, the restart/no-re-seed check and the re-seed. Testing rules forbid running bulk-delete/reset features even when the request asks, so these need a manual check.

minor.issue: Deleting a user (admin) removes only the users doc and leaves the db.auth record. Afterwards, login with the old credentials returns 200 with a token and user:null, and the email cannot be registered again ('Email già registrata'). Reproduced with a TEST_ user, then cleaned up by hand.

demo_targets matches linked docs only by tourId/orgId/userId. Notifications use a 'to' field ('user:<id>' / 'org:<id>'), so notifications created after seeding for demo users/orgs that have no tourId (e.g. welcome and quote notifications) would survive deletion as orphans. Messaggi/other collections that link users through other fields (from/to/partecipanti) may also be missed. Suggest also matching to in ['user:'+id, 'org:'+id].
Count moved from 282 to 283 during testing: automations add notifications linked to demo tours (expected behaviour, not a bug). Just note that the number changes.

issues: Right column of the search form (Ponti e festività, Parola chiave, Tema, Dal giorno, Cerca) runs past the white card's right edge and gets clipped
Main nav links (Viaggi, Ponti e festività...) sit at the top of the header and are not vertically centred with the logo and the Accedi/Registrati buttons
The email verification banner button says 'Ho cliccato il link (simula)' but it actually re-sends the verification email (verifyEmail -> /auth/resend). The label is misleading.

action_items: Manually verify DELETE /api/admin/demo: run it, confirm admin@ovigo.it can still log in, restart the backend and confirm there is no re-seed (meta demo_rimossa), then re-seed with the given mongosh command
In demo_targets, also match notifications by 'to' in user:/org: ids of the demo users and orgs (and check messaggi link fields)
When a user is deleted, also delete or deactivate their db.auth record (or have login reject auth records with no user)
Fix the mobile overflow of the search form grid; optionally vertically centre the header nav
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1518 lines and index.html is 4415 lines (single files, imported as-is). Not changed, per the 'do not rewrite' instruction.
adminDemo(): if GET /admin/demo fails, DEMO_INFO stays null and every renderAll triggers the call again with an error toast. Acceptable, but consider caching the error.
Endpoints parse raw request.json() without Pydantic models (validation is done by hand).
